newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cambier group to support Eurotunnel debt plan.
newsitem.headline: Cambier group to support Eurotunnel debt plan.

text.p: The head of the Eurotunnel Shareholders' Association representing small shareholders said on Thursday he would vote in favour of a debt restructuring plan for the channel tunnel operator.
Christian Cambier, the group's chief, when asked if he was voting in favour of the restructuring, told Reuters, "Yes."
Cambier said he holds 2.5 percent of Eurotunnel shareholder votes.
He was speaking ahead of a Eurotunnel shareholders' meeting to be held later on Thursday to vote on plans to restructure the company's 70 billion francs of junior bank debt.
